comments.author: DataIxBeautiful
comments.body:
Credit where it's due, you shipped and you're promoting it, which is more than most but none of this is new or really yours in the way your site implies. Combining signals, news, sentiment, and a heatmap isn't a first, TradingView and StockTwits have done versions for years.

  
With Firebase + admob, and then technical indicators on a price feed. News is an LLM summarizing public headlines, sentiment I imagine is a vote counter. Even the heatmap pic on your site is a stock photo from unsplash. 

  
Calling it a first and quant AI is vastly overselling a news reader with indicators bolted on. Good luck though, but since none of this is patentable, it'll be interesting to see how many of these style apps will emerge in the coming weeks/months etc. I should ship an app and make a quick buck huh

replies.author: OrchidProfessional54
replies.body:
I'm flattered by the stabbing compliment mate 😅. 

hmm the website undersells the app cuz honestly i only made the website to just have the policies of playstore taken care of. you know the privacy policy terms n conditions bla bla bla. 

well you got some stuff right some stuff wrong. it's alright though. it is complex a bit and I'll take that as my design fault but it's much more than that. 

Firebase is only used for authentication and social database. 

even google cloud handles only the social layer of the app..

the live prices, charts all on cloudflare. 

now let's come to the biggest misconception. 

the quant ai. it's quant engine as I don't have any blackbox AI playing around with indicators. running that for 200 assets n refreshing every 30 seconds would bankrupt me in a day. 

it's basically live indicators and some quant formulas I used to build an engine that gives a multi timeframe picture of what's been happening. i can lay out all the formulas I'm using and structure but I would rather keep it short. you can dm me to know more. i did honours in finance n quant from warwick university. somewhere in england, ik it's not london  but it is what I could get in 🫠

heatmap pic on website is meh. but you can check out the heatmap in the app. it's pretty good. 

especially my favourite is the stocks screen where i can see 6000+ global stocks easily in one place. you know tradingview can offer you that but by the time you go to 40 different pages. in my app it's there in one shot. 

decently optimized and updates every minute for stocks. 

again 15 second for macro asset(index forex n commodity) and 1min updates for stocks (cuz too many). 

also idk if you noticed i have a special AI made for translations as well. 52 languages. 

A global radio that you can turn on and it'll read you global news in short. in 52 languages. 

voice assistant to make your navigation easier. 

zone proximity alerts calculating liquidity levels n support resistance n all for watchlisted macro assets. 

there's 10 features more but ik your attention span has already run out. if not you can dm me to know more or well. 

explore the app. it's free ^^. even ads are not annoying. I'm definitely in loss because i kept small ads inside app but it's alright one day I'll breakeven. 

you are welcome to create an app but you should study my app properly before you start. 

it's a good practice to study your opponents properly before you draw your sword. i did the same last year.
